meshy_tasks.prompt: Voltarach, the thunder spider creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG: the SAME character with the same body shape, same eight spiked legs, same pose and same proportions as the 3D model render (first image), repainted to match the board reference art. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look, clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no scenery, no text. Absolutely no red, pink, maroon, crimson or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.
